lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council work session, where a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies is on the table — that one cuts right to who can actually afford to live here. The County commissioners also meet Wednesday to ratify an income-eligibility shift at Pinion Park to 80% AMI, a quiet threshold change with real consequences for housing access. Sprinkled through the week: the library opens its new youth area Wednesday, and the Stories in the Sky drone show lands Thursday.
